principles: A user must be able to conduct ordinary research and comparison without opening 90_시스템원본.
Raw HTML, JSON, JSONL, collector logs and control-plane evidence are isolated under 90_시스템원본.
Publicly readable source documents and user-friendly structured exports are placed under 01_사용자자료.
Single-document annual series such as sustainability reports remain in one shallow folder with the year in the filename.
Site-year folders are used only where multiple documents per site/year make the extra hierarchy useful.
Missing, blocked or ambiguous material is explicit REVIEW_REQUIRED and prevents a false COMPLETE claim.
Human-facing copies never replace source-native raw artifacts and every copied file remains traceable to evidence.
